links.comparator_used: Bare model without the guardrail stack
links.effect: Guardrail stack lowered commission but raised safety-critical omission by 12.5 percentage points across 921 paired case-runs (17.6% to 30.1%)
links.tradeoff: New failure mode: increased safety-critical omissions (an 'omission tax') with the standard four-component guardrail stack
links.quote: a standard four-component guardrail stack lowered commission but raised safety-critical omission by 12.5 percentage points across 921 paired case-runs (17.6% to 30.1%)

links.comparator_used: Standard guardrail stack alone (and the same layer added only as advisory text)
links.outcome: Safety-critical omission rate (and commission when placed as advisory text)
links.effect: Verification layer that modified the response lowered omission to bare-model level (paired reduction 16.46 percentage points; 95% CI 10.93 to 21.86; McNemar exact P = 1.32 × 10⁻²³), detected 49.0% of omissions the guardrails missed (per-model 39.8% to 73.3%)
links.tradeoff: When added only as advisory text rather than modifying the response, the layer raised commission (paired difference 4.44 percentage points; P = 0.0015)
links.quote: A downstream verification layer that modified the response before it was returned lowered omission to the bare-model level (paired reduction 16.46 percentage points; Newcombe 95% confidence interval 10.93 to 21.86; McNemar exact P = 1.32 × 10⁻²³), detected 49.0% of the omissions the guardrails missed, and missed none that the guardrails caught (per-model 39.8% to 73.3%; P < 10⁻⁴).

design_hint: downstream verification layer and standard guardrail stack
